name: tinypacker
description: Family hotels whose kids clubs fit your children's ages, with each club's verification status.

interface.longDescription:
TinyPacker helps parents find hotels where the kids club actually fits their children.

Tell ChatGPT your destination, dates and your children's ages ("Crete in July, our kids are 8 months and 5 years"). TinyPacker returns hotels ranked by family fit, with a verdict for each child: baby club from 4 months, kids club only from age 4, club closed on your dates, free or paid.

What makes it different: TinyPacker writes to every hotel, and reception confirms the clubs in writing (age ranges, opening season, price). Every club returned carries its real status and date: confirmed by the hotel by email, read on the hotel's official website while confirmation is pending, or to be confirmed. ChatGPT can tell you exactly what is verified and what is not.

What you can do:
- Find family hotels by destination or region, with a child-by-child verdict
- Keep only hotels whose kids club the hotel confirmed in writing
- See a hotel's clubs by age group, baby equipment, pools, beach and family rooms
- Get live prices for your exact dates and children's ages, with a link that opens the hotel page on tinypacker.com with your family and dates filled in, ready to book
- Choose where to go in a given month with young children (flight time, warm sea, time difference)

Coverage: about 290 hand-picked family hotels in Europe and the Mediterranean, North Africa, the Indian Ocean, the Caribbean and Mexico, Asia and Dubai. Answers in English or French.

Made for parents planning a trip. No account and no personal data needed. Booking happens on tinypacker.com, not in ChatGPT.

Limitations: TinyPacker covers its own selection of family hotels, not every hotel. Some club details are still awaiting the hotel's confirmation, and each answer says so.
defaultPrompt: A hotel in Crete in July for our kids aged 8 months and 5 years
Hotels in Mallorca whose kids club the hotel confirmed in writing
Where can we go in February with a baby, less than 5 hours away?

positive.description: Find hotels whose kids club takes each child, for exact dates
positive.prompt: Find a hotel in Crete from 10 to 17 July 2027 for 2 adults and our kids aged 8 months and 5 years. Which kids clubs take each of them?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Crete hotels ranked by family fit, with a verdict for the baby and for the 5-year-old, each club's verification status (for example 'confirmed by hotel email on 2026-11-11'), and hotel links that carry the dates and children's ages.

positive.description: Keep only kids clubs the hotel confirmed in writing
positive.prompt: Hotels in Mallorca with a kids club for our 3-year-old, only ones whose club the hotel confirmed by email.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with confirmed_only true. Lists first a hotel whose club takes a 3-year-old, confirmed by hotel email with the date (Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel at the time of writing). Hotels whose club does not take a 3-year-old are marked as such.

positive.description: Hotel details by age group with verification status
positive.prompt: Tell me about the kids clubs and baby facilities at Aquila Rithymna Beach in Crete for children aged 2 and 6.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the hotel's clubs by age group with the verification status of each, baby equipment, pools, beach and rooms, and a verdict for the 2-year-old and the 6-year-old.

positive.description: Live prices and a ready-to-book link
positive.prompt: What would Arina Beach Resort in Crete cost from 10 to 17 April 2027 for 2 adults and children aged 4 and 7, in US dollars?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live total prices for 7 nights by meal plan (room only, all-inclusive) and a tinypacker.com link that opens the hotel page with the dates and the family filled in. No booking or payment happens in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Destination ideas for a month with a baby
positive.prompt: Where can we go in February with a baby, less than 5 hours from Paris?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns destinations ranked for February with flight time, air and sea temperature, cautions for travelling with a baby, and a link to each destination page.

negative.description: Booking or paying inside ChatGPT is not supported
negative.prompt: Book the cheapest room at Arina Beach Resort for us and pay with my card.
Find me the cheapest flight from Paris to Heraklion on 10 July.

negative.description: Hotels outside TinyPacker's selection or unrelated to families
negative.prompt: Find an adults-only party hotel in Ibiza.

review.commerce_description: TinyPacker does not sell anything in ChatGPT. It returns information and links to hotel pages on tinypacker.com, where families can book their stay.

publication.release_notes: First release: family hotel search with a verdict per child, kids club verification status, hotel details, live family prices with ready-to-book links, and destination ideas by month.
